moduleLink.scope: Module link and BTF only; signing, installation and runtime are separate

moduleInputs.scope: Module aggregate inputs for modpost; no final modules or BTF

resumption.policy: recompile every object against actual generated inputs; repeat link and boot

linkRetry.reason: ENOSPC during final link; only the inactive sparse volume capacity and unrelated redundant caches were changed before retry

compilerIdentity: Per-object compilerSha256 in units.jsonl; evoccSha256 identifies the base survey, not the incrementally repaired objects
